== 45% ==
Three people are singing ‘Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes’. Tom does the four actions to match the lyrics. Dick always does the four actions in the reverse order to how they appear in the title. Harry does the four actions in alphabetical order. How many people touch their knees at the same time?

Tom – Head, Shoulders, Knees, Toes.<br>'''Dick''' – Toes, '''Knees''', Shoulders, Head.<Br>'''Harry''' – Head, '''Knees''', Shoulders, Toes.

== 25% ==
Maddie’s step counter watch starts at zero at the bottom of a staircase. She climbs 35 stairs but drops her watch to the very bottom and runs down to pick it up. When she gets to the top of the stairs, her watch says she has climbed 100 steps. How many steps long is the staircase?

100 steps minus the 35 she originally climbed means the staircase is 65 steps high. The steps on the way back down weren’t counted because she had dropped the watch.
